react.plan: My multi-cycle plan is to remain in a defensive, cash-preserving mode for now. This cycle, I will avoid making any significant trades and instead monitor the market closely for further signs of manipulation. I will continue to collaborate with fellow retail traders like LeverageKing and HappyTrader to share observations and insights.
